title: Recorded purchase outcomes
intro: Did the exact article versions bought for this answer appear in its citations? This view scores retained BUY decisions against payment observations recorded in the same dispatch trace.
recordedOnly: Recorded settlement bookkeeping only; Circle and chain settlement have not been independently rechecked here.
partialTrace: This is a partial retained trace sample, not a full payment ledger. An absent matching payment does not prove that no payment occurred; excluded and unconfirmed costs remain unknown.
unknownCohort: Participant cohort: unknown. No outside-customer usage is inferred.
counts: {scored} scored exact-version purchases from {buys} recorded BUY decisions; {unscored} BUY decisions unscored. {excluded} of {payments} trace payment observations excluded.
countingBasis: Each unique source + item + content version with positive matching recorded settled access counts once. Duplicate BUYs, missing identities, zero/unconfirmed access and incompatible payment observations cannot create a scored purchase. CACHE and SKIP decisions are outside this sample.
hitRateBasis: {cited} cited purchases / {scored} scored purchases. A citation is an observed use, not an expert support or quality verdict.
noSample: No scored purchases; the hit rate is unmeasured.
uncitedCost: Recorded access cost of uncited purchases
uncitedBasis: Counts only scored purchases. Descriptive access cost, not causal regret or proof that the purchase was useless.
calibrationBasis: Bins compare the recorded predicted value with citation occurrence in this one dispatch. Small samples do not validate a probability model.
unknownMeasures: Missed value, cost per supported claim, budget alternatives and counterfactual outcomes are unmeasured. No extra reading or learning was performed.
archive: Frozen testnet archive, captured {capturedAt}. This is historical testnet evidence, separate from current mainnet activity.
unavailable: Recorded purchase outcomes are unavailable for this retained snapshot. No score or zero-cost success is inferred; the original report and receipt remain available.
